data_direction: Read reference first; writeback only after approval
refresh_pattern: Manual CSV or read-only API pull after approval
minimum_fields: ticket_number; short_description; assignment_group; status; change_number; ci_reference; knowledge_article; opened_at; closed_at
sensitive_data_position: Avoid PHI/PII. Store only reference metadata and route links.
source_of_truth_boundary: ServiceNow remains workflow/source system. AssuranceLayer stores evidence linkage only.
approval_needed: ITSM owner, application owner, QA/Governance reviewer
safe_first_test: Load sample ticket reference CSV and map ticket_number to CSP record_id.
failure_mode: Ticket linkage may be missing or stale; do not block CSP readiness solely from unapproved ServiceNow data.

contract_name: Controlled Document / Deviation / CAPA Reference Contract
contract_type: Controlled document and QMS evidence reference
refresh_pattern: Controlled export or approved read-only reference
minimum_fields: document_id; document_title; version; lifecycle_state; deviation_id; capa_id; approval_status; effective_date
sensitive_data_position: Do not store controlled document content. Store IDs, titles, versions, and approval state only.
source_of_truth_boundary: Veeva remains controlled document/QMS source of truth.
approval_needed: QA, Document Control, Veeva owner, CSV/validation reviewer
safe_first_test: Map SOP/formula version evidence to sterile SOP drift register using document_id and version.
failure_mode: If Veeva references are missing, SOP/formula readiness must remain YELLOW or require manual reviewer rationale.

refresh_pattern: Controlled export or approved read-only API
minimum_fields: asset_id; asset_name; equipment_id; room_id; calibration_status; maintenance_status; work_order_id; due_date; review_status
sensitive_data_position: Equipment/asset metadata only. No product or patient data.
source_of_truth_boundary: Blue Mountain remains validated asset/equipment source of truth.
approval_needed: System owner, validation owner, QA, equipment/process owner
safe_first_test: Map hood/room/equipment IDs to sterile equipment-room drift register.
failure_mode: If asset status is unavailable, equipment/room readiness remains conditional.

refresh_pattern: Controlled CSV export first; API later only after approval
minimum_fields: user_id; display_name; access_role; access_status; approval_state; last_review_date; reviewer; exception_flag
sensitive_data_position: User identity metadata. Avoid unnecessary personal attributes.
source_of_truth_boundary: myAccess remains access governance source of truth.
approval_needed: IAM owner, access governance owner, QA/Governance reviewer
safe_first_test: Map technician role/access evidence to sterile personnel competency drift register.
failure_mode: If access evidence is missing, personnel/access readiness should be review-required.

refresh_pattern: Read-only Graph lookup or controlled directory export
minimum_fields: user_principal_name; display_name; email; object_id; account_enabled; department; group_membership
sensitive_data_position: Identity metadata only. Do not collect unnecessary HR or personal data.
source_of_truth_boundary: Entra remains identity source of truth.
approval_needed: IAM owner, security owner, app owner
safe_first_test: Normalize reviewer, custodian, technician, and sign-off actors.
failure_mode: If identity cannot be verified, sign-off/custody/personnel records should show identity-review required.

refresh_pattern: Application write/read within approved storage container
minimum_fields: register_name; blob_path; file_name; content_hash; uploaded_by; created_at; retention_label; evidence_id
sensitive_data_position: Do not store secrets in blob metadata. Sensitive evidence requires approved controls.
source_of_truth_boundary: Blob stores evidence/register artifacts; authoritative source remains defined per data object.
approval_needed: Azure owner, security owner, records/retention reviewer
safe_first_test: Store exported sterile register snapshots in controlled folder pattern.
failure_mode: If storage is unavailable, exports remain local/runtime only and should not be treated as retained records.

minimum_fields: hash_id; evidence_hash; snapshot_hash; dossier_hash; ledger_transaction_id; anchored_at; verification_status
sensitive_data_position: Hash-only payload. Never write PHI, PII, secrets, or evidence content to ledger.
source_of_truth_boundary: Ledger proves hash anchoring only; it does not store source evidence.
approval_needed: Security owner, cloud owner, QA/Governance reviewer
safe_first_test: Anchor freeze snapshot hash and verify transaction reference.
failure_mode: If ledger is unavailable, local hash verification continues but external immutability is not proven.

minimum_fields: record_id; csp_name; assurance_status; inspection_status; binder_status; maturity_score; route_health_count; readiness_score
sensitive_data_position: Use de-identified/metadata-only dashboard fields unless approved.
source_of_truth_boundary: Power BI is reporting layer only. It is not source of truth.
approval_needed: Analytics owner, data governance reviewer, business owner
safe_first_test: Load register exports into a sterile readiness dashboard dataset.
failure_mode: Dashboard may lag source registers; use refresh timestamp and snapshot hash for context.
